title: 第11章 待我如亲我不信第12章 成人礼试炼序列争锋
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
内心虽然惊喜，不过顾长歌面上依旧带着和煦笑容，并且更加热情的把给低阶修士打磨根基的丹药递给顾清秋。
“清秋妹妹，这里还有丹药。”
“这个开脉丹，可以庇护你的经脉，让你开脉更为顺畅。”
“这个是孕灵丹，孕灵境用的。”
“这个是聚灵丹，化液境用的。”
“还有……”
顾长歌热情的把一堆丹药递给顾清秋，等顾清秋回过神，怀里已经抱着一堆丹药了。
顾清秋眨了眨眼，美眸一片茫然。
究竟怎么回事？
顾清秋从碰到顾长歌开始，已经不知道脑海中浮现过多少次这样的想法了。
实在是没办法把面前的顾长歌和以前记忆中，那个自私自利的顾长歌比较在一起。
然而，顾长歌却眉头微微皱起，因为从刚才他给予顾清秋收下丹药之后，【无敌返还系统】竟然一次都没有触发返还？
怎么回事？
想到这里，顾长歌心中询问系统：“系统怎么回事？为什么不继续返还了？”
【叮，绑定目标每日只能返还一次！
“好吧。”
听到系统提示，顾长歌心里了然，本来也就做好了不返还的准备。
如果真的可以每天无限次数返还的话，那他岂不是可以叫顾青把长生顾家底蕴拿来，直接刷一遍，当场无敌，三千道域起飞了。
应该没有这么离谱，统子运作方式估计也支撑不了。
毕竟返还这玩意，应该是要消耗一点什么鬼东西的，就是不知道是什么而已。

“一个绑定目标每日一次，果然还得绑定多亿点目标！”
“这样虽说不能无限返还，但一天返还个十几次也够了。”
“一天一次还算好了，要是每周，每月，每年啥的，或者每一个境界那更蛋疼。”
顾长歌见好就收。
“好了清秋妹妹，你还有什么其他需要？有的话尽管给哥说。”
顾长歌问道。
“没了。”
顾清秋回神摇摇头，恭敬朝顾清秋拜谢：“多谢神子……哥哥。”
少女的声音如同清泉流水般好听，让前世至尊族妹喊自已哥哥是什么感觉？
顾长歌只想说，透心凉，心飞扬！
“嗯，对了，你有功法了吗？”
虽说已经知道顾清秋有虚空经，但顾长歌还是要问一下的。
“有了！”
顾清秋宁静道。
“那……”
顾长歌正想好好交流，跟这位至尊族妹打好关系，不过这个时候，储物戒中一枚传讯玉牌飞出。
顾长歌看了眼顾清秋，顾清秋起身想要离开，不过他并没有介意，而是当着顾清秋的面点开了通讯。
“长歌，来家族议事殿一趟！”
顾青的声音从传讯玉牌内传出。
声音消失，传讯玉牌缓缓飘落。

顾长歌伸手接住，重新放入储物戒之后看向顾清秋道：“父亲找我，那我就先去议事殿。”
content_en:
Although he was pleasantly surprised in his heart, Gu Changge still had a warm smile on his face, and handed Gu Qingqiu the elixir that was used to polish the foundation of low-level monks even more enthusiastically.
"Sister Qingqiu, there are still pills here."
"This meridians can protect your meridians and make them smoother."
"This is a pregnancy elixir, for use in the pregnancy realm."
"This is a spirit-gathering pill, used in the liquid-transformation realm."
"And..."
Gu Changge enthusiastically handed a bunch of pills to Gu Qingqiu. When Gu Qingqiu came to his senses, he already had a pile of pills in his arms.
Gu Qingqiu blinked, his beautiful eyes blank.
What's going on?
Ever since Gu Qingqiu met Gu Changge, he didn't know how many times this thought had appeared in his mind.
There is really no way to compare the Gu Changge in front of him with the selfish Gu Changge in his previous memory.
However, Gu Changge frowned slightly, because since he gave Gu Qingqiu the pill just now, the [Invincible Return System] has not triggered the return even once?
What's going on?
Thinking of this, Gu Changge asked the system in his mind: "What's going on with the system? Why don't you continue to return it?"
[Ding, the bound target can only be returned once a day!
"Okay."
After hearing the system prompt, Gu Changge understood clearly and was already prepared not to return it.
If it was really possible to return it an unlimited number of times a day, then couldn't he ask Gu Qing to bring the longevity Gu family's information and brush it directly, making him invincible on the spot, and the three thousand realms took off.
It shouldn't be that outrageous, and the way Tongzi operates probably won't support it.
After all, returning this thing should consume something, I just don’t know what it is.
"One bound target once a day, and sure enough, there are more than 100 million targets bound to it!"
"Although this cannot be returned indefinitely, it is enough to return it a dozen times a day."
"Once a day is fine, but if it's every week, every month, every year, or every realm, it would be even more painful."
Gu Changge gave up as soon as he saw it was good.
"Okay, sister Qingqiu, do you need anything else? If you have any, just tell me."
Gu Changge asked.
"No more."
Gu Qingqiu came to his senses and shook his head, and respectfully thanked Gu Qingqiu: "Thank you, Son of God...brother."
The girl's voice is as beautiful as clear spring water. How does it feel to have the supreme clan girl in the previous life call her brother?
Gu Changge just wanted to say, my heart is cold and my heart is soaring!
"Well, by the way, do you have any skills?"
Although he already knew that Gu Qingqiu had the Void Sutra, Gu Changge still wanted to ask.
"Yes!"
Gu Qingqiu said quietly.
"Then..."
Gu Changge was just about to have a good communication and establish a good relationship with this supreme clan girl, but at this time, a communication jade token flew out of the storage ring.
Gu Changge glanced at Gu Qingqiu, who stood up and wanted to leave, but he didn't mind and opened the communication in front of Gu Qingqiu.
"Changge, come to the family meeting hall!"
Gu Qing's voice came from the messaging jade tablet.
The sound disappeared, and the jade medal slowly fell.
Gu Changge reached out to catch it, put the storage ring back in, then looked at Gu Qingqiu and said: "Father is looking for me, then I will go to the meeting hall first."
